source.title: FDA: Outbreak Investigation of Salmonella: Moringa Leaf Powder (May 2026)

locators.quote: Sold at online stores including Amazon, eBay, and mogomoringa.com.
MOGO-brand Pure Moringa Oleifera capsules sold in white plastic bottles with a green label:
The Washington Department of Health collected an open container of MOGO-brand moringa powder capsules that was positive for the strain of _Salmonella_ causing illnesses in this outbreak.
Tennessee Department of Health collected an open container of MOGO-brand moringa powder capsules with the same strain of _Salmonella_ as the outbreak strain.
a total of 34 people infected with the outbreak strain of _Salmonella_ were reported from 14 states.
States with Cases: CA, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, MA, MD, MI, MN, NC, ND, NE, NH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
Hospitalizations: 11
Based on traceback records, FDA learned that MOGO Moringa LLC sourced all of their moringa leaf powder from India.
As of July 17, 2026, CDC has declared this outbreak over.
locators.quotePrefix: O Moringa LLC of St. Louis, MO.

locators.quote: Total Illnesses: 34

The Florida Department of Health also collected an open container of MOGO-brand moringa powder capsules which was positive for the same strain of _Salmonella_ as the outbreak strain and one other strain of _Salmonella_.
